knowledge:
- key_parameters: rulesGen=Takes a GRanges object (matrix of presences), target TF string (e.g., "TEAD4=1"), minimum support threshold, minimum confidence threshold, and a logical parameter 'type' (TRUE for LHS containing only present TFs, FALSE for present and/or absent TFs) ;; presAbs=Takes a string vector of all TFs, the generated rules, and a logical parameter 'type' matching the one used in rulesGen ;; rulesTF=Takes a TF item string, a set of rules, and a logical parameter 'verbose' to warn if the searched subset of rules is empty ;; IComp=Takes a TF item string, rules containing the TF, rules without the TF, and a logical parameter 'figures' to plot support and confidence distributions before and after TF removal
- alternatives: arules package=Used internally via the apriori function for association rule mining, but TFARM is preferred when subsequent mining is needed to evaluate the specific contribution (Importance Index) of items in the rules ;; arulesViz package=Mentioned as an alternative tool for general visualization of association rules ;; GMQL (GenoMetric Query Language)=Mentioned as a tool for preprocessing and extracting the initial genomic region data
- when_to_use: Appropriate when analyzing ChIP-seq or other genomic localization data to find direct or indirect interactions (co-regulation patterns) among transcription factors targeting a specific TF in genomic regions of interest (e.g., promoters)
- pitfalls: The matrix of presences (GRanges metadata) should not have rows with only 0 values, as regions with no transcription factors are considered uninteresting ;; Setting support and confidence thresholds too high or too low can result in either zero rules or an overwhelming number of rules; these thresholds depend heavily on dataset dimensions and target TF frequency ;; Using rulesTF with a TF that is not present in any rules will trigger a warning if verbose = TRUE ;; When computing pair importances, pairs not found in the generated rules must be avoided or filtered out (e.g., checking for NA or NULL) to prevent downstream errors

workflows.name: tf_association_rule_mining
workflows.intent: Extract association rules for a target transcription factor, compute the Importance Index for candidate co-regulators (individually and in pairs), and visualize the results.
input: matrix_of_presences.RData (A GRanges object where metadata columns represent transcription factors with 0/1 presence/absence values across genomic regions)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the genomic regions dataset (GRanges object) ;; 2. Generate association rules for a target transcription factor using rulesGen ;; 3. Identify candidate co-regulators (present/absent TFs in rules) using presAbs ;; 4. Extract rules containing a specific TF using rulesTF ;; 5. Generate corresponding rules without the specific TF using rulesTF0 ;; 6. Compute the Importance Index distribution for the TF using IComp ;; 7. Perform Principal Component Analysis (PCA) on the variations of support and confidence using IPCA ;; 8. Visualize the Importance Index distributions using distribViz ;; 9. Compute pair-wise Importance Indices for combinations of TFs ;; 10. Visualize pair-wise importances using a heatmap with heatI
workflows.code:
data("MCF7_chr1")
length(MCF7_chr1)
MCF7_chr1

r_TEAD4 <- rulesGen(MCF7_chr1, "TEAD4=1", 0.005, 0.62, TRUE)
dim(r_TEAD4)
head(r_TEAD4)

c <- names(mcols(MCF7_chr1))
c
lc <- length(c)

names(presAbs(c, r_TEAD4, TRUE))

p_TFs <- presAbs(c, r_TEAD4, TRUE)$pres
p_TFs

a <- presAbs(c[1:lc], r_TEAD4, TRUE)$abs
a

r_FOSL2 <- rulesTF(TFi  = 'FOSL2=1', rules =  r_TEAD4, verbose = TRUE)
head(r_FOSL2)
dim(r_FOSL2)[1]

r_CTCF <- rulesTF(TFi = 'CTCF=1', rules = r_TEAD4, verbose = TRUE)

r_noFOSL2 <- rulesTF0('FOSL2=1', r_FOSL2, r_TEAD4, MCF7_chr1, "TEAD4=1")

row.names(r_FOSL2) <- match(r_FOSL2$lhs, r_TEAD4$lhs)
row.names(r_noFOSL2) <- match(r_FOSL2$lhs, r_TEAD4$lhs)
head(r_noFOSL2)

imp_FOSL2 <- IComp('FOSL2=1', r_FOSL2, r_noFOSL2, figures=TRUE)
names(imp_FOSL2)

imp_FOSL2$imp

head(imp_FOSL2$delta)
head(imp_FOSL2$rwi)
head(imp_FOSL2$rwo)

DELTA_mean_supp <- vector("list", length(p_TFs))
DELTA_mean_conf <- vector("list", length(p_TFs))
all <- lapply(p_TFs, function(pi) {
  	A <- rulesTF(pi, r_TEAD4, FALSE)
  	B <- rulesTF0(pi, A, r_TEAD4, MCF7_chr1, "TEAD4=1")
    IComp(pi, A, B, figures=FALSE)
  })

for (i in 1:length(p_TFs)) {
    IMP_Z[[i]] <- all[[i]]$imp
    DELTA_mean_supp[[i]] <- apply(all[[i]]$delta[1], 2, mean)
    DELTA_mean_conf[[i]] <- apply(all[[i]]$delta[2], 2, mean)
}

  IMP <- data.frame(
      TF = p_TFs,
      imp = sapply(IMP_Z, mean),
      sd = sapply(IMP_Z, sd),
      delta_support = as.numeric(DELTA_mean_supp),
      delta_confidence = as.numeric(DELTA_mean_conf),
      nrules = sapply(IMP_Z, length),
      stringsAsFactors=FALSE
  )
  
  library(plyr)

IMP.ord <- arrange(IMP, desc(imp))
IMP.ord

colnames(IMP)
TF_Imp <- data.frame(IMP$TF, IMP$imp, IMP$nrules)
i.pc <- IPCA(DELTA, TF_Imp)
names(i.pc)

i.pc$summary

head(i.pc$loadings)

head(i.pc$scores)

distribViz(IMP_Z, p_TFs)

ZNF217_index <- which(p_TFs == 'ZNF217=1')

o <- IMP_Z[[ZNF217_index]] > 0
rule_o <- all[[ZNF217_index]]$rwi[o,]
rule_o[6,]

all <- all[[ZNF217_index]]$rwo[o,]
all[6,] 

couples_0 <- combn(p_TFs, 2)
couples <- paste(couples_0[1,], couples_0[2,], sep=',')
head(couples)

IMP_c <- lapply(couples, function(ci) {
  	A_c <- rulesTF(ci, r_TEAD4, FALSE)
  	if (all(!is.na(A_c[[1]][1]))){
	B_c <- rulesTF0(ci, A_c, r_TEAD4, MCF7_chr1, "TEAD4=1")
  	IComp(ci, A_c, B_c, figures=FALSE)$imp
	}
  })

I_c <- matrix(0, length(couples), 2)
I_c <- data.frame(I_c)
I_c[,1] <- paste(couples)

null.indexes <- vapply(IMP_c, is.null, numeric(1))
IMP_c <- IMP_c[!null.indexes]
I_c <- I_c[!null.indexes,]

I_c[,2] <- vapply(IMP_c, mean, numeric(1))
colnames(I_c) <- colnames(IMP[,1:2])

I_c <- I_c[!is.na(I_c[,2]),]
I_c_ord <- arrange(I_c, desc(imp))
head(I_c_ord)

I_c_2 <- arrange(rbind(IMP[,1:2], I_c_ord), desc(imp))
p_TFs <- sub("=1", "", p_TFs)
I_c_2$TF <-sub("=1", "",I_c_2$TF)

i.heat <- heatI(p_TFs, I_c_2)
